summary: Fase 28c — Bukti Kerja Berpasangan (Sebelum → Sesudah) testing completed. Backend APIs fully functional with proper photo pairing, privacy controls, and data structure. Frontend displays before-after repair evidence correctly in Punch Detail and Portal with comparison sliders. Site Plan unit detail could not be fully tested due to navigation/auth issues.

action_item_for_main_agent: Site Plan unit detail drawer navigation issue: When navigating directly to /site-plan after login, the page redirects to login. This prevents automated testing of the Pembangunan tab repair evidence. Please verify: (1) Site Plan requires re-authentication or has session issues, (2) Unit detail drawer Pembangunan tab displays repair pairs correctly when accessed through normal user flow, (3) All images in Site Plan repair section load with naturalWidth > 1. Backend API /site-plan/{project_id}/unit/{unit_id} returns correct repairs data, so this is likely a frontend routing/auth issue.
